config.description:
Configuration parameters for the connector. These configurations
are the minimum set of key-value pairs (KVP) which can be used to
define how the connector connects Kafka to the external system.
Some of these KVPs are common to all the connectors, such as
connection parameters to Kafka, connector metadata, etc. The list
of common connector configurations is as follows

- cloud.environment
- cloud.provider
- connector.class
- kafka.api.key
- kafka.api.secret
- kafka.endpoint
- kafka.region
- name

A specific connector such as `GcsSink` would have additional
parameters such as `gcs.bucket.name`, `flush.size`, etc.

cloud.provider.description: The cloud service provider, e.g. aws, azure, etc.

connector.class.description: The connector class name. E.g. BigQuerySink, GcsSink, etc.

name.description: Name or alias of the class (plugin) for this connector.

kafka.api.secret.description: The kafka cluster api secret key.

tasks.description: List of active tasks generated by the connector

connector.description: The name of the connector the task belongs to

type.description: Type of connector, sink or source
